blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Saying that agency heads traditionally appear before Congress to defend their budgets, Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian questioned Vice President Sara Duterte’s absence at the Senate on Thursday to defend her office’s proposed P785.2-million appropriation for 2027. Instead of Duterte, her chief of staff, lawyer Zuleika Lopez, and other Office of the Vice President (OVP) officials faced the Senate subcommittee on finance, headed by Sen. JV Ejercito. “I only have one question. Atty. Zuleika, as chief of staff, may I know where the vice president is?” Gatchalian asked. “Traditionally, during budget deliberations like this, the head of the office […]...
